title: Carpet Recipe
description: Fixes the bug for carpet recipe in the newest version
body:
# 🧶 Carpet Recipes Datapack (26.3)

**Craft every carpet color with simple, balanced recipes!**  
This datapack adds intuitive crafting options for all Minecraft carpet variants, making decoration smoother and survival‑friendly.

### 🎨 Features
- 🧵 Crafting recipes for **all 16 carpet colors**
- 🛠️ Fully compatible with Minecraft **26.3+**  
- 🌍 Works in singleplayer, multiplayer, and modded servers
